items.description: The Queen's Park Savannah is the cultural heart of Port of Spain, serving as a massive recreational park and host for major events.
Cleaver Woods is a popular eco-park offering a peaceful escape into the lush natural environment of eastern Trinidad.
The sugarcane belt in Caroni reflects the historical and ongoing importance of agriculture to the local life and landscape.
The Aripo Savannas are a unique protected ecosystem, known for their rare flora and vital biodiversity in Trinidad.
The Nariva Swamp is a vast freshwater wetland, home to diverse wildlife and significant to the island's natural heritage.
The Bush Bush Sanctuary, within the Nariva Swamp, provides a vital refuge for endangered species and local biodiversity.
The Trinity Hills represent a significant range of natural beauty and biodiversity in the southern part of Trinidad.
The coconut groves in Toco define the scenic coastal landscape of the northern tip of Trinidad.
Pigeon Point is the premier destination for leisure and water activities on the western coast of Tobago.
Buccoo Reef is a vibrant marine environment in Tobago, offering unique opportunities for snorkeling and nature study.
